slug: 2025-03-31 Vodacom opens data center in Maputo, Mozambique

facts.fact: Vodacom launched a $25 million carrier-neutral data centre at Tchumene, Matola, said to be the country's largest, with direct access to the 2Africa cable; the Prime Minister attended the launch (reported 2025-03-31).

note: Other facts in the document (18 data centres in the country, iColo and Raxio presence) are not facts for hire/tier.
